title: payment.succeeded payload
description: The 'payload' content of an EventEnvelope whose 'type' is 'payment.succeeded', version 1. Published by payment-service on the 'learning.events' exchange (data-model.md, research.md R1); consumed by enrollment-service (research.md R6).

paymentId.description: The Payment.id that succeeded; becomes Enrollment.sourcePaymentId.

courseId.description: The course to enroll the user in.

amountCents.description: The whole-unit amount charged; zero for a free course.

occurredAt.description: When the payment transitioned to SUCCEEDED, UTC.
